title: ‘Susindro Connect’ App Launched to Improve Public Access to Services in Khurai
summary: Khurai MLA Leishangthem Susindro Meitei launches the ‘Susindro Connect’ app to improve access to government schemes, public assistance and direct communication with residents.
body:
IMPHAL, November 2, 2026: MLA Leishangthem Susindro Meitei on Sunday launched ‘Susindro Connect’, an official mobile application aimed at strengthening public connectivity and improving access to development initiatives and government services in Khurai Assembly Constituency.

The launch programme was held at the MLA’s residence at Khurai Sajor Leikai.

Speaking at the event, Susindro said the application had been developed to help residents access information about government schemes and development programmes while providing a direct communication channel with their elected representative.

**Support for Students and Residents in Need**
According to the MLA, the application will also help address requests from students seeking financial assistance for education, individuals requiring support for medical treatment, and residents affected by natural disasters such as floods and storms.

Residents will be able to submit grievances and requests for assistance directly through the platform, enabling the MLA to take up their concerns and facilitate timely intervention.

**Available on Google Play Store**

The application will be available for download through the Google Play Store and is scheduled to remain operational for one year.

Susindro also cautioned users against engaging in fraudulent or improper activities through the application.

The initiative is expected to provide an additional channel for public engagement and improve communication between the MLA and residents of Khurai Assembly Constituency.
